content.title: Celestial Typography Variant | Orbit, Pulse and Gravity as Words
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult original observer and fixed celestial coordinate anchors. Require a visible gaze, hand or body action before each exact semantic word appears. Build each word from a measurable orbital, waveform, axis or gravity behavior inside the same space. Escalate from body-scale diagrams to cosmic scale while preserving observer identity and coordinate continuity. Collapse the celestial system back to the same observer and one readable terminal word.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject and a clockwork coordinate system before text moves. + Require one visible subject action before each exact word engages a mechanical duty. + Assign each word one distinct pendulum, gear, spring, rewind or loop behavior. + Escalate mechanical scale or disorder while preserving subject identity and the same coordinate system. + Return every mechanism to a readable zero state around the same adult identity anchor.
quick_start.recommended_input: In an original dark ocean laboratory, establish one clearly adult East Asian oceanographer in a white utility suit beside a circular black research pool; lock face, short hair and pool axes. Her hand sweeps once and the exact words 'TIDE' and 'DEPTH' appear separately as a rising ring and descending vertical scale inside the same pool. All contours retract into one droplet beside her eye; the same adult faces camera and the exact final word 'RETURN' settles in a thin circle behind her.
